scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@jupas/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=chispapp-frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=chispapp
scripts.test: npm test --workspace=@jupas/shared && npm test --workspace=chispapp-frontend && npm test --workspace=chispapp
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace=@jupas/shared && npm run lint --workspace=chispapp-frontend

scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build --workspace=@jupas/shared && npm run dev --workspace=chispapp-frontend
